name: dead-claude-skills
description: deadmade's personal Claude Code setup: own skills plus the third-party plugins used on every machine.

plugins.name: dead-skills
plugins.description: Default bundle: global instructions, and pulls in the core plugins of this marketplace as dependencies.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Brainstorming, subagent driven development with built in code review, systematic debugging, and red/green TDD.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that works. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.

plugins.name: nix-lsp
plugins.description: Nix language server (nixd) for code intelligence (requires nixd on PATH)

plugins.name: mcp-basic
plugins.description: Basic MCP servers for every machine: Context7 (up-to-date library docs).

plugins.name: mcp-github
plugins.description: GitHub's hosted MCP server (repos, issues, PRs, Actions). Opt-in per machine.

plugins.name: mcp-azure
plugins.description: Azure DevOps Server MCP server (self-hosted, PAT). Opt-in per machine, configure with /plugin configure.

plugins.name: atlassian
plugins.description: Atlassian's official plugin: Rovo MCP server for Jira and Confluence (OAuth sign-in via /mcp) plus skills. Opt-in.

plugins.name: mattpocock-picks
plugins.description: Curated Matt Pocock skills that complement superpowers: the productivity skills plus grilling with domain docs, spec → tickets and architecture deepening. Opt-in.

plugins.name: pstack-picks
plugins.description: Curated skills from poteto's pstack, rewritten for Claude Code: how/why, adversarial review, unslop, architect/arena, principles. Opt-in.

plugins.name: tob-picks
plugins.description: Curated Trail of Bits skills: property-based testing, spec-to-code compliance, sharp-edges API and config review, mutation-testing analysis. Opt-in.

plugins.name: rust-skills
plugins.description: Rust best practices from Apollo GraphQL's handbook (rust-best-practices): ownership, errors, clippy, testing, dispatch. Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: csharp-skills
plugins.description: Microsoft's .NET skills (dotnet/skills): C#, testing, MSBuild/NuGet, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, EF Core, MAUI, WinForms, behind six C#-only router skills. Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: postgres
plugins.description: Postgres best practices (Neon's postgres-best-practices) and safe, non-blocking migrations (Timescale pg-aiguide's postgres-database-migration). Vendored, synced weekly. Opt-in.

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Graphify: turn a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph (/graphify). Needs the graphify CLI (uv tool install graphifyy). Opt-in.

plugins.name: feature-flow
plugins.description: /feature-flow: brainstorm with prior art, grill with domain docs, plan, have Claude evaluate the plan, then execute and finish through superpowers. Two approval gates, no lock. Opt-in.

plugins.name: self-review
plugins.description: /self-review: review your branch before opening a PR. Bug pass, spec and standards pass, security-review, a CLAUDE.md audit, and specialist agents (vendored from code-review, pr-review-toolkit and mattpocock) in one command, then fixes what you pick. Opt-in.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: Hallmark: anti-AI-slop design skill for web frontends, scoped to browser UI work. Vendored from nutlope/hallmark. Opt-in.

plugins.name: paper-lookup
plugins.description: Paper lookup: search arXiv, Semantic Scholar, OpenAlex, Crossref, Unpaywall and other scholarly APIs (trimmed for computer science) for papers, citations and open-access full text. Vendored from K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills. Opt-in.

plugins.name: cswap
plugins.description: claude-swap in Claude Code: accounts pane, /swap, usage status line, opt-in auto-switch. The installer downloads cswap.exe on Windows. Opt-in.

plugins.name: tui-review
plugins.description: /tui-review: a fast, stacked-branch-aware diff pane beside the chat, so you can ask Claude about what you read. Needs the brv binary, which the installer downloads. Opt-in.
